name: Heartlands
description: The noble kingdom of humanity, featuring rolling hills, medieval castles, and bustling villages

musicalTheme.style: Heroic orchestral JRPG, Nobuo Uematsu inspired
musicalTheme.instruments: French horns, strings, timpani, flutes, folk guitar

tracks.name: Heartlands Journey
tracks.sunoPrompt: Triumphant orchestral JRPG exploration theme in D major with bold French horn fanfares and sweeping cinematic strings and adventurous folk guitar melody with warm medieval village atmosphere and hopeful march rhythm at moderate tempo with classic 16-bit Final Fantasy nostalgia

tracks.name: The Wanderer's Rest
tracks.sunoPrompt: Warm medieval tavern music in D major with lively folk fiddle and friendly acoustic guitar and cheerful tin whistle melody with cozy fireside atmosphere and merry drinking song rhythm at upbeat tempo with welcoming village inn hospitality

tracks.name: Merchant's Square
tracks.sunoPrompt: Pleasant medieval marketplace music in D major with light orchestral strings and cheerful recorder and gentle folk guitar with bustling village square atmosphere and welcoming commerce rhythm at moderate tempo with friendly human kingdom warmth

tracks.name: Riverside Serenity
tracks.sunoPrompt: Peaceful pastoral fishing music in D major with gentle acoustic guitar fingerpicking and soft flute melody and warm string pads with tranquil countryside riverside atmosphere and relaxed contemplative rhythm at slow tempo with lazy afternoon serenity

tracks.name: Echoes of the Fallen Kingdom
tracks.sunoPrompt: Melancholic ancient ruins music in D minor with haunting solo French horn and sorrowful strings and distant flute echoes with crumbling stone castle atmosphere and mysterious puzzle-solving tension at slow tempo with faded glory of lost human kingdoms
